FN-35WAEZ-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 68
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Representative Shedd
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 03/16/2023
House Bill 68 as introduced would increase the obligations of the Alabama Department of
Economic and Community Affairs (ADECA) by a department-estimated $20,000 annually by
providing for the reimbursement of the actual amount of travel expenses incurred by ADECA
employees for certain in state travel, if pre-approved by the Governor.
Page 1

FN-35WAEZ-2
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 68
Committee: Finance and Taxation General Fund Sponsor: Representative Shedd
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 05/01/2023
House Bill 68 as passed the House of Representatives would increase the obligations of the
Alabama Department of Economic and Community Affairs (ADECA) by a
department-estimated $20,000 annually by providing for the reimbursement of the actual
amount of travel expenses incurred by ADECA employees for certain in state travel, if
pre-approved by the Governor.
Page 1

FN-35WAEZ-3
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 68
Committee: Finance and Taxation General Fund Sponsor: Representative Shedd
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 05/10/2023
House Bill 68 as reported by the Committee on Finance and Taxation General Fund could
increase the obligations of the various state departments and entities by an undetermined amount
by providing for the reimbursement of the actual amount of travel expenses or the per diem rate
incurred by employees for certain in state travel.
